Singing archer: Double Strafe and Melody Strike for damage, team songs for allies, Unchained Serenade to blunt a caster; kites like a Hunter.
Avoids melee and Silence; carries arrows, Blue Potions, Fly Wing.

lines.text: DEX/STR Divest Rogue. Back Stab for damage, Divest Weapon / Shield / Armor / Helm to weaken tough single targets, Gank and Mug for income; Hiding to recover. A support-leaning thief rather than a farmer.
Avoids packs (strips are single-target) and Undead/Boss-protocol mobs that resist stripping; picks medium monsters with gear to strip.
engine role: tank / bait (Thief line with AGI >= 2 x STR or AGI >= 30: evasion tank (partyRole))
tactics: the tank leads: picks and pulls the target, peels monsters off squishy members
Utility DPS: Divest Weapon first (-25% ATK) then Divest Shield or Armor on the boss at most twice each, Back Stab for damage; never wastes strips on trash.
Brings Awakening Potion, White Potions, spare Divest items, Fly Wing.
Disarming duelist: strips an opponent's weapon/shield/armour, then Back Stab; thin on HP but strong vs geared melee.
Avoids casters (strips do not matter); carries White Potions, Fly Wing.

lines.text: Trapper. Claymore Trap (2 Traps) or Land Mine on the cell the monster walks to, Blast Mine / Freezing Trap / Sandman to control, falcon Blitz Beat for the rest; kites around its traps. Needs a Trap stock (50z each) and restocks every trip.
Avoids running out of Traps, 4+ monsters without Claymore, fast flyers.
engine role: ranged (Archer / Mage line: ranged (partyRole))
tactics: hangs back on the tank's target: kites walkers, casts area spells on groups
Trap control: Ankle Snare + Claymore Trap on the boss's path, Freezing Trap / Sandman on adds, Land Mine for burst, Blitz Beat from range. Long prep, little SP.
Brings 60+ Traps, a Blue Potion, Concentration Potion, Fly Wing.
Trap field: Ankle Snare, Land Mine, Claymore and Shockwave Trap (SP drain) around the party's line; strong holding a spot, weak when ambushed.
Avoids open rushes; carries many Traps, arrows, Fly Wing.

lines.text: Tank-ish Monk. Occult Impaction (Investigate) as the damage skill, Mental Strength (Steel Body: huge DEF/MDEF, but slow) against packs, Triple Attack combos for finishing, Dodge; VIT/STR makes it a slow, safe solo farmer.
Avoids long fights at low SP and spots where being slowed is fatal; rests with Spiritual Cadence.
engine role: tank / bait (Monk / Champion: frontline (partyRole case 15, 4016))
tactics: the tank leads: picks and pulls the target, peels monsters off squishy members
Off-tank: Mental Strength (Steel Body) while the boss swings, Occult Impaction burst, Root (Blade Stop) to hold a melee boss, combos when SP allows.
Brings Blue and White Potions, Yggdrasil Berry, Awakening Potion.
Durable duelist: Steel Body gives huge DEF/MDEF at the price of speed, Occult Impaction burst, Root to stop one melee attacker; easy to kite.
Avoids fast kiters; carries Blue and White Potions, Fly Wing, Yggdrasil Berry.
